list: the official 55 trophies, checked against six guide pages (five read on 2026-11-19, TechWiser on 2026-11-21)
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list and are unchanged. Guides are numbered steps in original wording, each citing the pages that state it. Each dispute is labelled: sources disagree, two different targets, wording only, or an unconfirmed trigger; both versions and our call are given. Early launch-week data (18 Nov 2026); it may change.

ppx.name: PowerPyx: GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap

zone.name: GTA Zone: GTA 6 trophies and achievements

tw.name: TechWiser: All GTA 6 trophies and achievements

roadmap.title: Story and optional missions
roadmap.detail: Play the five chapters and take optional missions as they appear (100% wants any 100 of several hundred, so there is no need to chase them all). Scan new vehicles and study animals as you go. Accept Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1: it is the only possibly missable trophy. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so one playthrough does it. Keep cheats off: they disable trophies and saving.

roadmap.title: 100% Completion checklist and challenges
roadmap.detail: The checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) opens after the story. PowerPyx calls it lenient, closer to 60% of true completion: 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations, 200 of 277 vehicles. Robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests must be done in full. Nothing on the checklist is missable.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks, character quests and cleanup
roadmap.detail: Finish 8 stranger strands plus the Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret lines. They are needed for trophies but not for the 100%. Then mop up one-off trophies and the unconfirmed ones, and let the platinum pop.

steps.text: The platinum has no task of its own; it unlocks when the other 54 trophies are earned.
Budget about 200 hours on one playthrough (Sixshore quotes 250+); there is no difficulty setting and no PS4 version.
Take the Chapter 1 balcony meditation early so the one possibly missable trophy is not left behind.
Keep cheats off for the whole save: they switch trophies and saving off.
Watch the tracker: with 54 of 54 other trophies earned, the platinum should pop.
Finish Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1.
GTA Zone words it as one of the first missions; either way it is plain story progress.
It cannot be missed.
The trophy unlocks when the last mission of Chapter 1 ends; nothing extra is required.
Before the chapter closes, take the balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).
The official text says to complete Chapter 2.
PowerPyx words it as starting Chapter 3, so it pops at the Chapter 2 to 3 handover.
Either way it is story progress and cannot be missed.
The trophy pops at the end of Chapter 3.
GTA Zone says no story trophy can be missed.
Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs are also where the Snap Gun comes from (see Sneakthief).
The trophy pops at the end of Chapter 4.
Chapter 4 also opens the optional bank-vault mission used for Maximum Withdrawal; weigh that before starting Chapter 5.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Complete the final mission.
CryptoGames notes Beebom and CULTR say Chapter 5 while the official text says final mission; treat them as the same moment.
Save before it: free roam stays open afterwards, but there is no mission replay.
Not missable.
Finish the mission Breakfast Run.
GTA Zone places it in Chapter 2.
It is a story mission and cannot be missed.
Finish The Cartel Heist.
GTA Zone says it is a Chapter 3 mission.
It is a story mission and cannot be missed.
Finish Child's Play.
GTA Zone says it is a Chapter 4 mission.
It is a story mission and cannot be missed.
Finish Headliners.
GTA Zone says it is a Chapter 4 mission.
It is a story mission and cannot be missed.
Finish VCIA Takedown.
GTA Zone says it is a Chapter 4 mission.
It is a story mission and cannot be missed.
Finish Operation Savage Glory.
GTA Zone says it is a Chapter 5 mission.
It is a story mission and cannot be missed.
Finish the story first: the 100% Completion checklist opens afterwards and earlier progress counts.
Hit the checklist targets: 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals.
Do in full: all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 42 shooting-range golds and all drone races.
Nothing on the checklist is missable.
CryptoGames lists 30 unique races for the 100% where the others say 20, so check the in-game list.
PowerPyx rates the checklist as lenient, about 60% of true completion.
Complete 250 stunts of any type, out of 397 in the world.
The 100% needs 300, so this trophy arrives first.
CryptoGames reports that flying under bridges is the quickest type.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

steps.text: Try each of nine activity types once.
PowerPyx's list: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, an arcade game, winning a race or drone race, and doing a stunt.
Most happen while chasing other trophies; check the in-game list and fill any gap.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.text: Earn a gold medal in every shooting range challenge: 42 challenges across 12 ranges.
The 100% also demands all 42, so there is no shortcut: practise each range until gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps.text: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
42 races exist in total, and all 42 count toward the 100%.
Win 20 different races out of 40.
Winning the same race twice does not add to the count.
CryptoGames lists 30 won races for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.text: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
GTA Zone says he texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon.
Fishing is also one of the nine Master of None activities.
Finish one arcade game; any of them counts.
It also counts toward Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps.text: Finish the last mission in Andy's line, five quests in PowerPyx's count.
GTA Zone notes Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so it needs its own run.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.text: Complete Kenton's treasure-diving line, which covers seven shipwrecks.
Underwater discoveries are also fully required for the 100%.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.text: Finish Billy's five jobs.
GTA Zone says they start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission and stay open after the story.
They do not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps.text: Complete 8 stranger strands.
Not every character counts: GTA Zone confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not.
The strands are not part of the 100%.
TechWiser warns that several stranger chains have missable windows tied to story progression, and CryptoGames repeats the warning; both say to start each chain as soon as it unlocks.

trophies.window: Several stranger chains have missable windows tied to story progression (TechWiser; CryptoGames repeats it).
trophies.lastChance: Start each strand as soon as it unlocks.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.text: Complete Randy's wish list of 16 sports cars.
Collect them while exploring so the last few do not need a long hunt.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.text: Do Tyrone's labs, then his follow-up quest.
Tyrone's strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.text: POSSIBLY MISSABLE: in Chapter 1 Lucia offers a meditation on the balcony of Jason's house the morning after Down to Earth; it is gone after the chapter.
It raises the meditation counter but is not one of the 18 marked spots, so nobody has confirmed the trophy needs it.
PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it; it takes about a minute.
Then meditate at all 18 marked spots across 10 locations.
The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2.
The 100% only asks for 15 of 18, so this trophy cannot cost A Long Road.

trophies.window: Chapter 1: Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth.
trophies.lastChance: Before Chapter 1 closes; it is gone for good afterwards.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.text: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
His hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only.
Which animal unlocks the trophy is unconfirmed.
Bret's quests must be fully completed for the 100% anyway, so finish them all.

trophies.window: No window documented; the animal that triggers it is unconfirmed.
trophies.lastChance: Finish all of Bret's quests, which the 100% needs anyway.

steps.text: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets.
The 100% asks for 15 sets; three full sets arrive well before that.
Pick up cards as you meet them.
Use WAiNK on 100 locations; any mix counts.
GTA Zone splits the pool into Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags.
PowerPyx says 100 scans are needed.
Complete 50 of the 80 challenges; 70 are needed for the 100%.
Work them alongside everything else.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps.text: Reach 4 stars with your partner and lose the heat.
PowerPyx and CryptoGames both suggest a train tunnel north of Ambrosia.
Bank-vault jobs often hand you the wanted level; PowerPyx expects it to land during the optional bank mission.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.text: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner and keep the wanted level flashing between them.
The jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together.
CryptoGames adds: rob a fourth if it does not pop after the third.
Discover 100 vehicles; scanning them with WAiNK counts without driving.
The 100% wants 200 of 277 base models, so scan every new car from the first hours.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: Kill 5 enemies within one use of Combat Focus.
Fill the meter first and use an assault rifle.
Gang members seem to count; police, soldiers and civilians do not.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.text: Steal a passenger jet parked at a VCIA terminal gate.
Take off and get about 1 km away.
Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station.
Shoot enemies from inside it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.text: Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs.
Use it on the back door of a jewelry store, find the safe code and empty the safe unseen.
PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds.
Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape; all 8 are needed for the 100%.
They open with the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…': follow a security van into a bank while the vault is open.
Expect 4 stars, so keep a fast bike ready.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.text: Rob an armored truck and escape.
A bank-vault robbery counts too if you get away, so it often lands with Maximum Withdrawal.
Clear the fog from the whole map.
A plane is the quickest way to uncover the dark patches.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.text: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs.
39 operations exist, and all of them count toward the 100%.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.text: The official hint is a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
PowerPyx says to drink an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar.
GTA Zone and CryptoGames still list the trigger as unconfirmed; try the bar first.

trophies.lastChance: Try the Ocean View Rooftop Bar (PowerPyx) and recheck the sources.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.text: PowerPyx: drive the specific blue Banshee through a showroom window, which needs the Key Cloner.
GTA Zone and CryptoGames call the steps unconfirmed and only suggest driving out through the window.
Treat the details as unproven.

trophies.lastChance: Keep the Key Cloner and a Banshee in mind; recheck the sources.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.text: PowerPyx: steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling and escape.
GTA Zone: rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police.
CryptoGames calls the wording unclear; it reads as the same job in different phrasing.
Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia through gym training.
Working out together trains both.
500 actions count toward your Criminal Profile; it should come naturally.
Avoid pushing toward the permanent Irredeemable profile.
CryptoGames notes this detail is single-source.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.text: Most sources have not confirmed the trigger.
PowerPyx suspects it relates to the Payday Loans store in the prologue.
Do not rely on this.

trophies.lastChance: Do not rely on it; it should pop as you play, recheck the sources.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.text: The official hint is: what the hell just happened.
PowerPyx says it is the UFO easter egg, seen at night near Starlet Motel after 2 AM.
GTA Zone and CryptoGames still call it unconfirmed.

trophies.lastChance: Try near Starlet Motel after 2 AM (PowerPyx); recheck the sources.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps.text: The trigger is unconfirmed; the hint is a melee drive-by.
PowerPyx believes it is kicking enemies while on a motorcycle.
Treat as unproven.

trophies.lastChance: Try kicking enemies from a motorcycle (PowerPyx); recheck the sources.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.text: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through fences; it is a running total.
GTA Zone says Yasmani pays the most; CryptoGames says one fence does.
CryptoGames adds that the total builds during the 100% robberies.
Spend $100,000 across shops as a running total.
It usually happens by itself.
Buy all 8 garages from the Vice City Real Estate app, about $160,000 in total.
The 4 story garages do not count.
Do this before On the Spot, which needs free garage space.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2.
You need free garage space, so buy garages first.

roadmapNotes: Total: about 200 hours to the platinum, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough (PowerPyx, GTA Zone, CryptoGames). Sixshore quotes Push Square at 250+ hours, so the estimate varies.
Only 1 trophy is flagged possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude. PlanetGTA6 says it cannot tell yet whether any are missable; all other sources agree the story trophies cannot be missed.
Open points: 27 vs 28 hidden trophies (attribution unclear), 15 vs 18 meditation spots (two different targets, not a disagreement), and some one-off triggers marked UNCONFIRMED.
Saving: 15 manual slots plus an autosave (Sixshore). Save at the start and end of each chapter.
missableNote: Positive Mental Attitude is the only trophy flagged as possibly missable (PowerPyx, repeated by GTA Zone and CryptoGames). Optional missions expire, some quest givers or fences leave and some timed quests fail, but the sources say none of that affects a trophy or the 100%.

disputes.q: Two different meditation targets: how many spots does each one want?

a.say: 15 of 18 spots: the target for the 100% Completion checklist (A Long Road)

b.say: All 18 marked spots: what the Positive Mental Attitude trophy asks for ("every spot")

disputes.call: Not a disagreement: the same sources give 15 for the 100% and 18 for the trophy. Meditate at all 18 and both are met.

disputes.q: How many trophies are hidden: 27 or 28?

a.say: 28 hidden: the 27 hidden bronze plus the hidden gold, which is how the tracker marks them

b.say: 27 hidden: the count of the hidden bronze table alone (TechWiser lists 27 hidden bronze)

disputes.call: The earlier data only records that the sources give 27 and 28 without saying which source says which; a bronze-only count versus all hidden trophies is the likely cause. The tracker masks 28; the count changes no step.

disputes.q: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required for Positive Mental Attitude?

a.say: Unconfirmed: it raises the meditation counter but is not one of the 18 marked spots, so nobody has shown the trophy needs it

b.say: PowerPyx did it before earning the trophy, so do not skip it

disputes.call: Do it in Chapter 1: it costs about a minute and removes the risk.

a.say: One possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude

b.say: Too early to say whether any are missable

disputes.call: Treat Positive Mental Attitude as missable and take its Chapter 1 meditation.

disputes.q: Does the 100% want 20 or 30 races won?

a.say: 20 unique races (the trophy count; the other sources only mention 20)

b.say: 30 unique races for the 100% checklist (only CryptoGames lists 30)

disputes.call: Win 20 for the trophy; check the in-game 100% list before assuming the other 10.

b.say: 250+ hours (Push Square, as quoted by Sixshore)

disputes.call: Plan for 200 and keep slack up to 250.

disputes.q: When does the Chapter 2 trophy pop? (wording only)
disputes.call: Same moment, the Chapter 2 to 3 handover; no action differs.

disputes.q: Is the last story trophy tied to Chapter 5 or to the final mission? (wording only)

b.say: Complete Chapter 5 (Beebom and CULTR, as noted by CryptoGames)

disputes.call: Treat them as the same moment and save before the final mission.

disputes.q: Unconfirmed trigger: how do you trigger In The Beginning…?

a.say: Drink an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar

disputes.call: Try the rooftop bar first, and recheck the sources if it does not pop.

disputes.q: Unconfirmed trigger: how do you trigger Capital Offense?

a.say: Drive the specific blue Banshee through a showroom window, using the Key Cloner

b.say: Steps unconfirmed; only 'drive out through the window' is suggested

disputes.call: Do the PowerPyx version, which also satisfies the vaguer one.

disputes.q: Unconfirmed trigger: what triggers The Truth Is Out There?

a.say: The UFO easter egg near Starlet Motel after 2 AM

disputes.call: Visit at night after 2 AM; treat it as unproven until a second source confirms.

disputes.q: Unconfirmed trigger: what triggers Ten Pin?

a.say: Kicking enemies while on a motorcycle

b.say: Trigger unconfirmed; the hint only says melee drive-by (the earlier data says only "unconfirmed" without naming sources)

disputes.call: Try the motorcycle kick; do not plan around it.

disputes.q: Unconfirmed trigger: what triggers Bad Luck, I Guess?

a.say: Possibly the Payday Loans store in the prologue

b.say: Trigger unconfirmed (most sources; not itemised in the earlier data)

disputes.call: Do not rely on it; let it pop naturally.

disputes.q: How is the Bowling trophy worded? (wording only)

a.say: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling and escape

b.say: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police

disputes.call: Same job: rob the operation, take all three valuables, lose the police.

disputes.q: Which fence pays most for marked bills?
disputes.call: Use Yasmani first; the $250,000 total is cumulative either way.
